definition.zh-TW: 列出公司在某一天擁有什麼、這些東西是用誰的錢換來的。左邊是資產；右邊說明資產的來源：欠別人的算負債，屬於股東的算股東權益。兩邊一定相等，因為資產的每一塊錢都有來源。標題只寫一個日期，換一天看，數字就不同。
definition.en: Lists what the company owns on a given day and whose money paid for it. Assets sit on the left; the right side explains where they came from: amounts owed to others are liabilities, and what belongs to the shareholders is equity. The two sides always agree, because every dollar of assets has a source. The heading carries a single date; look on a different day and the figures change.
